items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The helper overloads its parameters: `if isinstance(field_name, Q): predicate = field_name; partition_by = instances`. Names no longer match what is passed in. The window/order_by rewrite (`OrderBy(expr.expression.source, ...) if is_ref`) and `set_empty()` when `low_mark != 0` have no comments.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The clear_limits/filter/set_limits block in _apply_rel_filters is copy-pasted three times (reverse FK, M2M, generic). The forward-FK/reverse-O2O changes add more duplicated code and go beyond the issue. The helper is reused from contenttypes through an overloaded Q/list signature.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Raising NotSupportedError when `supports_over_clause` is false is a good guard. But forward FK and reverse O2O quietly call `queryset.query.set_empty()` for any nonzero low_mark, so data disappears with no error and the semantics are arguable.

items.name: Per-parent slice semantics for open/bounded slices
items.name_zh: 开放/有界切片按父对象分区
items.evidence: `Window(RowNumber(), partition_by=partition_by, order_by=...)` with `__gt` low_mark and `__lte` high_mark only when `high_mark is not None` handles the slice per parent in SQL. `queryset._chain()` runs before `clear_limits()`, so the caller's queryset is not mutated.
